title: Personal obligations of trustee.
bodyText: Trust property is not subject to personal obligations of the trustee, even if the trustee becomes insolvent or bankrupt.
bodyHtml: [§554D-507]  Personal obligations of trustee.  Trust property is not subject to personal obligations of the trustee, even if the trustee becomes insolvent or bankrupt. [L 2021, c 32, pt of §2]
